en.title: D.B.T.S
en.decryption: Remember these as the 'Big Four' evolution points of Gupta Temples: Deogarh (Dashavatara), Bhitargaon (Terracotta), Tigawa (Kankali Devi), and Sanchi (Temple 17).

hi.title: D.B.T.S
hi.decryption: Remember these as the 'Big Four' evolution points of Gupta Temples: Deogarh (Dashavatara), Bhitargaon (Terracotta), Tigawa (Kankali Devi), and Sanchi (Temple 17).

fact.en: Mistaking Gupta temples for Dravidian style; Gupta temples were the precursors to Nagara, not Dravidian.
fact.hi: Mistaking Gupta temples for Dravidian style; Gupta temples were the precursors to Nagara, not Dravidian.

fact.en: Assuming all Gupta art was religious; secular and courtly art flourished in frescoes (Ajanta).
fact.hi: Assuming all Gupta art was religious; secular and courtly art flourished in frescoes (Ajanta).

fact.en: Confusing terracotta with stone; Bhitargaon is unique for being a brick-built temple.
fact.hi: Confusing terracotta with stone; Bhitargaon is unique for being a brick-built temple.
